items.title: Live: Trump threatens new US strikes, saying Iran's 'taken too long' to make deal
items.description: Donald Trump has threatened to strike Iran's power plants and bridges, saying they 'have to pay the price' for taking too long to negotiate. Follow live.

items.title: Belfast attack suspect appears in court as victim loses eye
items.description: Hadi Alodid, a 30-year-old man from Sudan, appears in a Belfast court charged with attempted murder over a stabbing attack that triggered anti-immigrant violence in several parts of Northern Ireland.

items.title: Sea drone saves US helicopter crew downed in waters near Strait of Hormuz
items.description: A look at the US Corsair sea drone used in a first of its kind mission to rescue two helicopter crew shot down near the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Illegal peptides are everywhere. Now authorities are cracking down
items.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration has launched a crackdown on unregulated peptides, saying increased illegal imports were posing a risk to consumers.

items.title: High Court decision could lead to tens of millions of dollars worth of immigration claims
items.description: There are warnings a High Court ruling allowing a man to sue for false imprisonment over his indefinite immigration detention will lead to more claims running into the tens of millions of dollars.

items.title: Bear attack in Japan car park captured on CCTV as cities record more and more wild encounters
items.description: Bear encounters are rising in Japan, and the problem is not confined to the wilderness.

items.title: Hundreds protest against Pauline Hanson as WA Labor seats on 'hit list'
items.description: A crowd of roughly 400 protesters demonstrates against One Nation's Pauline Hanson as she speaks at a sundowner event in Perth's eastern suburbs.

items.title: 'National reluctance' to discuss abuse of Indigenous children, says ex-minister
items.description: A review has begun into the family circumstances of Kumanjayi Little Baby leading up to her disappearance and death, which relatives hope will find answers.

items.title: The abortion debate explained
items.description: Since 2023, abortion has been decriminalised nationwide – and polling consistently shows that  most Australians support that. However, now, abortion access is being debated in three different parts of the country. See what's behind the push to revisit abortion laws and what impact the debate may have.

items.title: Hong Kong authorities charge seven people after deadly fire
items.description: The seven people charged included directors and inspectors of a consultancy firm involved in the estate's renovation.

items.title: Fisherman attacked after treading on crocodile in northern WA
items.description: Authorities have confirmed the 35-year-old man was fishing in waist deep water at Barred Creek, north of Broome, when he was bitten.

items.title: When does the FIFA World Cup start and who are the favourites?
items.description: The FIFA World Cup is the biggest single-sport event on the planet and has delivered numerous historical moments, from Diego Maradona's "hand of God" in 1986 to Zinedine Zidane's infamous headbutt on Marco Materazzi.

items.title: Twelve dead, nine injured after late-night shooting near Johannesburg
items.description: Police launch a manhunt for more than 10 suspects who launched a late-night attack at the Jumpers informal settlement in the Johannesburg suburb of Cleveland.

items.title: Military officers behind acid attack on Indonesian activist sentenced
items.description: Four military intelligence officers are sentenced to up to three years in jail, after they threw sulphuric acid over a human rights activist in a brazen attack in Central Jakarta.

items.title: Shaggy dog tale as Bruce rescued after being blown out to sea in kayak
items.description: Bruce, a dog, has been rescued from the North Sea after drifting away in an inflatable kayak.

items.title: State government admits ex-Greens candidate battered by police officer
items.description: Lawyers for the state government have admitted police "battered" former Greens candidate Hannah Thomas at a pro-Palestinian rally in Sydney last year.

items.title: O'Callaghan chasing Titmus and 'the impossible' as she misses world record
items.description: Mollie O'Callaghan shoots out of the gates in the 200m freestyle but cannot maintain the world record pace as she books her ticket to the Glasgow Commonwealth Games.

items.title: Why was Rolf Harris never tried for his crimes in Australia?
items.description: Rolf Harris's conviction for child sexual abuse was shocking to those who saw him as a lovable larrikin. But the people who were abused by him are refusing to stay silent about the impacts of his crimes.

items.title: Hayley's husband escalated control during her pregnancy. Her story is not uncommon
items.description: Pregnancy is a time of greater autonomy and self-awareness for women. Because domestic violence is about power and control, a pregnancy can challenge that for a person who is using abuse.

items.title: Finding and saving the world's biggest trees before they disappear
items.description: It took a decade for researchers to find the tallest tree in East Asia. Now they know where the 84.1-metre conifer is, but the future of its species and other tall trees is dire.

items.title: NDIA employee charged over alleged $5m fraud plot against NDIS
items.description: Australian Federal Police charge a 48-year-old Adelaide woman over an alleged plot to steal $5 million from the National Disability Insurance Service and a disability services provider.

items.title: Woolworths to offshore hundreds of corporate jobs
items.description: Supermarket giant Woolworths will begin consultations with potentially affected staff today after announcing plans to shift some operations offshore.

items.title: Protests erupt in Belfast after stabbing attack, homes, cars and bus set on fire
items.description: Protesters hold anti-immigration demonstrations in Northern Ireland and England after a Sudanese man is arrested over a "brutal" knife attack in Belfast.

items.title: 'When Neale spoke, people felt it': Daniher farewelled at MCG funeral
items.description: Family, friends, members of the AFL community and dignitaries attend the service to remember the AFL legend, MND campaigner and former Australia of the Year.

items.title: Why Bunnings moving a store 10km down the road has caused such a stir
items.description: A plan by hardware giant Bunnings move its Bunbury store 10km to a neighbouring shire has angered and concerned residents and businesses.
